description: Source code defining the OutgoingWebhook model, related payloads, response handling, validation, and trigger word methods for Mattermost.

classes.name: OutgoingWebhook
classes.description: Represents an outgoing webhook configuration with properties like ID, token, creator, trigger words, callback URLs, and display info.

classes.name: OutgoingWebhookPayload
classes.description: Payload structure sent by the webhook, including token, team, channel, user info, and message details.

classes.name: OutgoingWebhookResponse
classes.description: Response structure for webhook responses, including text, username, icon, props, attachments, and response type.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the webhook's properties for auditing purposes.

methods.name: ToFormValues
methods.description: Converts the payload data into URL-encoded form values.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the webhook's properties, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Initializes ID, token, and timestamps before saving.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates the timestamp before updating the record.

methods.name: TriggerWordExactMatch
methods.description: Checks if a given word exactly matches any trigger word.

methods.name: TriggerWordStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a given word starts with any trigger word.

methods.name: GetTriggerWord
methods.description: Retrieves the trigger word matching the input, either exact or prefix match.
